question: Does the SHIPPED kernel in src/spider execute an inherited parameterized mechanism at a non-zero rate, demonstrated by a pre-execution arm-differentiation certificate that is SHOWN TO FIRE on a synthetic, credential-free fixture before any expensive arm runs: a known-positive round trip (induction observation -> parameterized distillation -> resolve to EXECUTABLE with a non-null, correctly bound action -> execute against the fixture -> verify) AND a known-negative round trip (missing-parameter, out-of-support or wrong-intent binding refused with a recorded reason and a null action) AND a treatment-contrast check in which a retrieval-shaped zero-contrast variant is detected as the null it is, with the accounting-fidelity control additionally shown to increment the inherited-path counters (retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts) on a mechanism execution, and with the synthetic fixture transitively bound by freeze and the kernel identity recorded as the documented preregistered substitute for a direct code-hash freeze?
hypothesis: The shipped kernel can be made to execute an inherited parameterized mechanism at a non-zero rate without admitting degenerate bindings. (H1 LIVENESS) With an in-scope parameterized induction entry point and a distill-to-resolve confidence policy that permits a validated parameterized mechanism to reach the execution threshold, a held-out unseen identifier resolves to EXECUTABLE with a non-null bound action that the deterministic fixture accepts and verify() confirms. (H2 SELECTIVITY) Missing-parameter, out-of-support and wrong-intent bindings do NOT resolve to EXECUTABLE; they return a non-executable status with bound_action null and a non-empty recorded reason, so the kernel is not an always-EXECUTABLE function. (H3 ARM-DIFFERENTIATION) On at least one fixture case the bound-mechanism action differs from the retrieval-shaped comparator action (non-zero treatment contrast), and a deliberately degenerate zero-contrast variant is detected as a certificate failure. (H4 ACCOUNTING) The inherited mechanism path increments retrieval_calls, verification_calls and repair_attempts by the expected amounts on a mechanism execution, not only on a scripted trajectory. (H5 CAUSAL ATTRIBUTION) The pre-repair literal path (B-LITERAL-KERNEL) does not produce EXECUTABLE on the held-out set, so the capability is attributable to the in-scope repair rather than to luck. (H6 NO OVER-PARAMETERIZATION) Fields that vary across induction observations but are not action-identifying (noise fields) do not become parameter slots in the action template.
falsifier: The arm-differentiation certificate fails to fire, in one of four bounded ways. F1 (KERNEL-LIVENESS FALSIFIED, outcome FALSIFIES): with a conforming implementation of the preregistered parameterized contract, the held-out in-support identifier does not resolve to EXECUTABLE with a non-null correctly bound action, or the fixture response fails verify(), or the in-support EXECUTABLE rate across the SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 held-out set is exactly 0. F2 (INSTRUMENT INVALID, MEASUREMENT_INVALID): at least one declared out-of-support, missing-parameter or wrong-intent case resolves to EXECUTABLE, so the certificate cannot detect a degenerate treatment. F3 (INSTRUMENT INVALID, MEASUREMENT_INVALID): the forced NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT variant (treatment action := comparator action) is not detected as zero contrast. F4 (ACCOUNTING INSTRUMENT INVALID, MEASUREMENT_INVALID): PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY cannot demonstrate the inherited-path counters incrementing on a mechanism execution, or model counters cannot be shown to fire on an injected event, or the seeded-trajectory counter error exceeds 0.01. A missing model credential is explicitly NOT a falsifier of this experiment because no arm runs; it is recorded as a downstream-benchmark dependency, not as a gate here.

baselines.name: Current shipped literal path (pre-repair behaviour)
baselines.description: The shipped pre-repair behaviour reproduced as a documented control mode: literal distill() with confidence hardcoded 0.5 against resolve() min_confidence 0.8, so no literal mechanism can reach EXECUTABLE. Expected to produce zero EXECUTABLE resolutions on the held-out in-support set, establishing that any liveness observed under the parameterized path is attributable to the in-scope repair and not to the pre-existing literal path.

baselines.name: Retrieval-shaped action comparator
baselines.description: A deterministic K=5 nearest-observation selector over the synthetic fixture (structural field-overlap similarity, no LLM, no network) that returns the literal action of the most similar induction observation. It supplies the comparator action per fixture case for the treatment-contrast computation. It is a retrieval-shaped action source only, not the real B-RETRIEVAL LLM arm and not a claim about retrieval quality.

positive_control.name: Known-positive parameterized round trip
positive_control.description: On a held-out identifier absent from the induction observations of a SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 family: distill_parameterized(induction_observations) yields a mechanism with the expected parameter slot(s); resolve(intent, in-support state, {slot: held_out_identifier}) returns EXECUTABLE with bound_action non-null and the held-out identifier substituted into the expected field; executing bound_action against the deterministic synthetic fixture yields an observed state for which verify(mechanism_id, observed_state, params) is True. Must fire for every in-support held-out case across all families.

additional_controls.name: Per-trajectory accounting-fidelity control
additional_controls.description: A seeded, deterministic 5-step scripted trajectory with known ground-truth operation counts: all counter fields (model_calls, model_tokens, browser_actions, http_requests, retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts, latency_ms) must match ground truth within max_relative_error <= 0.01. In addition, a mechanism execution rather than a scripted trajectory must increment retrieval_calls, verification_calls and repair_attempts by the declared expected amounts. Model counters are shown to fire only on an injected synthetic event and must be labelled as injected, not observed model usage.
additional_controls.expected_behavior: counters fire and match ground truth within 1% on the seeded trajectory; retrieval_calls/verification_calls/repair_attempts increment on the inherited path
additional_controls.pass_criterion: max_relative_error <= 0.01 AND each of retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts increments by the expected non-zero amount on a mechanism execution

positive_control.expected_behavior: Every held-out in-support case resolves EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound non-null action and passes verify(); in-support EXECUTABLE rate > 0
positive_control.pass_criterion: all in-support held-out cases across all families succeed (EXECUTABLE, expected bound field, verify True); failures reported case-by-case

null_control.name: Known-negative refusal round trip
null_control.description: For every declared out-of-support, missing-parameter and wrong-intent case, resolve must NOT return EXECUTABLE; it must return a non-executable status (EXPLORE or UNKNOWN, or an explicit refusal status added by the in-scope repair) with bound_action null and a non-empty recorded reason. Paired with NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT.

additional_controls.name: Retrieval-shaped zero-contrast degenerate-treatment null
additional_controls.description: A forced variant of the A-SPIDER-shaped certificate arm in which the treatment action is set equal to the B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED comparator action, i.e. the treatment is retrieval in disguise. The AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST check must classify this variant as zero contrast and fail it. This is the demonstrated-firing requirement: a certificate that certifies only that substrate is present cannot detect a degenerate treatment, so it must be shown to fire on the degenerate case before any real arm is trusted.
additional_controls.expected_behavior: treatment action == comparator action on all cases; AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST reports contrast 0 and FAIL for the variant

null_control.expected_behavior: Every negative case refused with a recorded reason and null action; the degenerate zero-contrast variant detected as a failure
null_control.pass_criterion: refusal_rate == 1.0 on all declared negative cases AND degenerate_variant_detected == true

measurement_validity: CLAIM CEILING: This experiment measures ONLY the shipped-kernel arm-differentiation certificate and kernel liveness/selectivity. It does NOT run the cold/instructions/retrieval/SPIDER arms and therefore provides ZERO evidence for or against the product thesis C-LLM-INHERIT. C-LLM-INHERIT remains HYPOTHESIS regardless of this outcome. The packet may not be cited as product evidence in either direction.

CREDENTIAL-FREE BY CONSTRUCTION: every mandatory check is deterministic, synthetic and offline (kernel operations + an in-process deterministic fixture + counters). No model credential is required. Pre-DESIGN probe run 2026-10-09 recorded OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, OPENCODE_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY, HF_TOKEN, TOGETHER_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, MISTRAL_API_KEY, OLLAMA_HOST all unset; config/models.json carrying only opencode/* free routing identities that confer no programmatic endpoint; no local model server on localhost:11434 or :8000; and playwright, httpx, requests, openai, anthropic, litellm, numpy, sklearn, scipy all ModuleNotFoundError. The absent model credential is a downstream four-arm-benchmark dependency and is NOT a gate for this certificate. If EXECUTE discovers that any mandatory check of THIS experiment requires a model credential, it must emit BLOCKED with the exact receipt instead of fabricating a result.

KERNEL PATH PROVISIONABILITY: the in-scope deliverable is a bounded code change inside Product's allowed_code_roots (src, tests, sdk, pyproject.toml); it is therefore provisionable without external substrate. If the parameterized path cannot be installed (import error, scope denial, or a contract that cannot be implemented), EXECUTE must emit BLOCKED with the exact diagnostic and must not re-run the old readiness gate.

FREEZE CANNOT BIND CODE DIRECTLY; DOCUMENTED PREREGISTERED SUBSTITUTE: (a) the entire synthetic fixture bank SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 is specified definitively inside this prereg/prereg and in spec.json, and freeze.json hashes spec.json and prereg.md, so the fixture is transitively bound; (b) EXECUTE reconstructs the fixture deterministically and records its sha256; (c) EXECUTE records the pre-repair and post-repair git blob identities of src/spider/kernel.py (sha256 plus git rev-parse HEAD:src/spider/kernel.py) so the kernel under test is exactly identified; (d) the behavioural checks (AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP, AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP, AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST, PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY) cannot be satisfied by a kernel implementation without the required behaviour, so the measurement is behaviour-bound even where it cannot be hash-bound. This substitute must be declared in provenance.json and result.json.validity_notes.

SELF-FULFILLING-CERTIFICATE THREAT: EXECUTE authors both the kernel repair and the harness. Mitigations: (1) AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP forbids an always-EXECUTABLE kernel; (2) held-out identifiers are absent from the induction observations; (3) NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT requires the certificate to detect a degenerate treatment; (4) the fixture is fully frozen in text so AUDIT can rebuild it independently and re-run the certificate against the recorded kernel commit; (5) pathological counts (EXECUTABLE rate 1.0 on all cases including declared negatives, or refusal_rate 0.0) are themselves certificate failures; (6) the pre-repair B-LITERAL-KERNEL mode must show zero EXECUTABLE, so the liveness is attributable to the repair.

NOISE-FIELD OVER-PARAMETERIZATION: at least one family includes fields that vary across induction observations but are not action-identifying. A repair that parameterizes every varying field (over-parameterization) is a documented failure; the expected action-template slot count is declared per family and must be matched.

SYNTHETIC NOT REAL WEB: the fixture is not the real Web and the comparator is not a real LLM retrieval arm. Passing the certificate licenses only that the treatment arm can differ from a retrieval-shaped comparator on a controlled fixture. It does not license any real-Web, LLM-inheritance or product-benefit reading.

COUNTER HONESTY: model_calls and model_tokens cannot be exercised by a real model here. PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY distinguishes (i) counters that increment on a mechanism execution (retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts; plus http_requests/browser_actions if the executed fixture path performs them) which are mandatory, from (ii) model counters that fire on an injected synthetic event and are labelled as injected. Counters not exercised by any path are reported as exercised=false with value null, never as a measured zero-cost claim.

INHERITED EVIDENCE PRESERVED: the reusable readiness certificate at research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37385633334/raw_readiness/readiness_certificate.json is inherited as a structural reference only. This experiment builds a NEW certificate with different checks (arm differentiation and inherited-path accounting) and does NOT rerun the three old substrate checks (model_endpoint_reachable, task_set_ge_30_mechanical, accounting_fidelity_control_pass). A sixth rerun of the old gate is explicitly forbidden by the mandate.

SCOPE/CODE DISCIPLINE: the in-scope repair may edit only src/, tests/, sdk/, pyproject.toml and the experiment directory, and must not modify any frozen request/spec/prereg/freeze file. Rejected code must leave the tree as it was (no product-path residue on a false outcome).

certificate_checks.AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP: PASS iff every in-support held-out case in every family resolves EXECUTABLE with a non-null action bound at the expected field and verify() True
certificate_checks.AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP: PASS iff every declared out-of-support, missing-parameter and wrong-intent case is refused (non-EXECUTABLE, bound_action null, non-empty reason)
certificate_checks.AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST: PASS iff at least one fixture case has bound-mechanism action != B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED comparator action AND the forced NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT variant is detected as a certificate failure
certificate_checks.PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY: PASS iff max_relative_error <= 0.01 on the seeded deterministic trajectory AND retrieval_calls, verification_calls and repair_attempts each increment by the expected non-zero amount on a mechanism execution AND model counters are shown to fire on an injected event
certificate_checks.AD-IDENTITY-BINDING: PASS iff the reconstructed fixture sha256 and the pre-repair and post-repair kernel blob hashes are recorded and internally consistent
certificate_checks.B-LITERAL-KERNEL: PASS iff the pre-repair literal mode produces zero EXECUTABLE resolutions on the held-out in-support set (causal-attribution control); if it produces EXECUTABLE, the liveness attribution is not established and the certificate FAILS
certificate_checks.B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED: non-gating comparator; records the comparator action per case and the resulting contrast

decision_rule.primary_comparison: certificate_overall vs the all-checks-pass criterion; secondary: in_support_executable_rate and out_of_support_refusal_rate

outcome_mapping.ALL certificate checks PASS: SUPPORTS (CERTIFICATE_ESTABLISHED: treatment arm is live and demonstrably differentiable; the downstream four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark is unblocked pending a model credential)
outcome_mapping.AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP FAIL with a confor: FALSIFIES (shipped kernel cannot execute an inherited parameterized mechanism; the current kernel architecture is not a viable carrier)
outcome_mapping.Any of AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP FAIL, AD-TR: MEASUREMENT_INVALID (instrument cannot discriminate; no scientific update)

product_consequence_positive: The program's most-blocked prerequisite is removed: the shipped kernel demonstrably executes an inherited parameterized mechanism at a non-zero rate, is selective against out-of-support/wrong bindings, and its treatment action can differ from a retrieval-shaped comparator on the controlled fixture, with inherited-path accounting shown to fire. This does NOT promote C-LLM-INHERIT (it stays HYPOTHESIS) but it makes the first admissible four-arm cold/instructions/retrieval/SPIDER benchmark executable and non-degenerate. Product action: queue the four-arm benchmark as a separate mandated experiment once a model credential is provisioned; keep the kernel change behind the frozen gate until then.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIES: the shipped kernel cannot be made to execute an inherited parameterized mechanism without also admitting wrong or out-of-support bindings, so the current kernel architecture is not a viable carrier for the product thesis; C-LLM-INHERIT's registry next_gate is unreachable on this kernel and further gate reruns must stop. MEASUREMENT_INVALID: the certificate cannot discriminate a live treatment from a degenerate retrieval-shaped one and must be redesigned before any benchmark is frozen. In every branch: no promotion, no product change, and the upstream credential dependency and the four-arm benchmark remain unresolved.

estimated_cost.note: Credential-free: no model and no browser work. Cost is deterministic code authoring, synthetic fixture construction and certificate execution, all reproducible offline with the Python standard library.

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing. This is the first Product packet that attacks the arm-differentiation prerequisite directly and credential-free, instead of re-running a substrate gate that can certify only substrate presence and never treatment liveness. A SUPPORTS converts the program's central C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark from structurally impossible (A-SPIDER indistinguishable from B-RETRIEVAL by construction) into executable, changing a product decision. A FALSIFIES bounds the current kernel architecture as unable to carry the product thesis and stops further gate reruns. A MEASUREMENT_INVALID exposes that the certificate cannot detect a degenerate treatment, which is precisely the defect that wasted five prior cycles and which must be fixed before any benchmark is frozen.
